trader.description: trader: account opening the synthetic leveraged position. Collateral will be escrowed from this address into the module account; no borrowed/held coins are transferred to the trader in synthetic mode.

pool_id.description: pool_id: target two-asset pool providing price reference and borrow caps. The two allowed denoms for collateral/borrow/held must match this pool.

collateral.description: collateral: coin to escrow as security. Must be positive and one of the pool denoms.

borrow.description: borrow: liability coin. Must be positive and one of the pool denoms. Interest accrues on this amount until close/liquidation.

cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.title: Coin
cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.description: Coin defines a token with a denomination and an amount. NOTE: The amount field is an Int which implements the custom method signatures required by gogoproto.
